info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Direct Debit Mandate-spec
info.description: The Direct Debit Mandate Creation API enables the establishment of direct debit mandates for specific banking accounts. This functionality allows businesses to facilitate automated payment processes by creating and managing mandates tied to their accounts. It is particularly useful for service providers that require recurring payments, such as utility companies and subscription services. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and e-commerce platforms looking to streamline payment operations. Leverage this API to ensure efficient direct debit setups and enhance customer experience.

post.summary: Create a Direct Debit Mandate for a specified account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new Direct Debit Mandate associated with the specified account. Ensure that the account exists and the necessary details are provided in the request body to successfully create the mandate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new direct debit mandate for the specified account. It should contain all the necessary information required to set up the mandate, including payment details and authorization. Please ensure that the schema aligns with the required structure for successful processing.

201.description: Successfully created a new direct debit mandate.
